en.app.notMonitored: Your entries are private notes. No doctor sees them in real time.
en.app.privacy: Stored only on this computer · no account, no cloud, no analytics
en.app.disclaimer: SymptoPage records your own observations. It does not diagnose, change treatment or decide whether you have recovered.

en.now.title: Something happening now?
en.now.body: Capture the moment while it is fresh: choose a symptom and add a few words.

en.welcome.title: Record symptoms. Show them to your doctor.
en.welcome.body: A symptom journal that helps you prepare for your appointment and follow what the doctor recorded.

en.welcome.f2: Notes about how you feel, in one place
en.welcome.f3: A short report ready for the visit
en.welcome.noDemo: Your journal starts empty. There is no sample data.

en.observation.reasonHint: Describe in your own words what you want to discuss…
en.observation.followUpIntro: The new observation keeps a link to the previous one.

en.visit.suggestedFromOutcome: Date taken from the follow-up date you recorded. Check it before saving.

en.daily.saved: Today's answer saved · you can change it
en.daily.missingNote: Days without an answer are shown as “no record”, not as “no symptom”.

en.entry.intro: Choose a symptom. Everything else is optional.
en.entry.customRequired: Enter a name for the symptom.
en.entry.timeCaptured: Set to the moment you pressed the button. Change it if the symptom started earlier.
en.entry.timeEdit: Recorded on {created}. Changing the event time does not change that.

en.entry.noObservations: No active observations — the record will be general.

en.entry.deleteShared: This record is linked to {n} observations and will disappear from all of them.
en.journal.empty: Your journal is ready. Add an observation when you need to.
en.outcome.title: After the visit
en.outcome.intro: Write down what was said, in your own words or copied from the visit document.
en.outcome.returnAdvice: When the doctor said to come back earlier
en.outcome.saved: Visit results saved. The visit is marked as done.
en.source.label: Source
en.prescription.title: Prescriptions, tests and deadlines
en.prescription.intro: Record it exactly as written by the doctor.
en.prescription.coursesHint: Reminders follow the course you entered, not the text above.
en.attachment.title: Documents and photos
en.attachment.intro: PDF, JPEG or PNG up to 15 MB. Files stay on this computer; their text is not read or sent anywhere.
en.attachment.deleteBody: The copy stored in SymptoPage will be deleted. Your original file is not affected.
en.med.notice: Record courses exactly as prescribed. SymptoPage does not suggest doses and never advises changing, doubling or stopping a medication — ask your doctor or pharmacist.
en.med.needObservation: Add a doctor and observation first.
en.course.intro: Copy the name, dose and schedule from the prescription.
en.course.name: Medication
en.course.indefinite: No end date (doctor did not set one)
en.course.timesHint: Local time on this computer. After travelling to another time zone the same clock times apply.
en.course.needTimes: Add at least one time and one day.
en.course.safety: Reminders only repeat what you entered. A reminder is not a taken dose.
en.course.endNotRecovery: A finished course only means the planned dates have passed. It says nothing about recovery.
en.course.stopBody: Use this when your doctor stopped the medication. Future reminders end; recorded doses are kept.
en.course.deleteBody: {n} recorded dose mark(s) will also be deleted.
en.course.deleteInstead: To keep the history, mark the course as stopped instead.
en.progress.notice: These charts show only what you recorded. They cannot tell whether you have recovered or whether treatment works — discuss that with your doctor.
en.progress.selfIntro: Your own assessment for today, per observation.
en.progress.coverage: Records on {recorded} of {total} days; {missing} days without any record.

en.progress.notEnough: Not enough records to compare the two halves (recorded days: {a} and {b}).
en.progress.disclaimer: Fewer records does not mean fewer symptoms.
en.report.includeGeneral: Include general records (not linked to a doctor)
en.report.badRange: The start date is after the end date.
en.report.disclaimer: Personal records kept by the patient. Not a diagnosis. Counts reflect only what was recorded.
en.report.noRecords: No symptom records in this period.
en.report.gapNote: Days without a record are unknown, not symptom-free.
en.report.assessmentNote: Subjective answers, not a clinical measurement.
en.report.marksNote: “Not marked” means no answer was recorded, not that the dose was missed.
en.report.noEvents: No symptom events in this period.
en.report.footer: Generated by SymptoPage from the patient's own records.
en.help.title: Seek medical help earlier than your planned appointment
en.help.intro: If your symptoms worsen or you are worried, do not wait for the planned visit. Urgency does not depend on whether a visit is private or public.
en.help.notMonitored: Your entries are not seen by a doctor in real time. Recording a symptom does not notify anyone.
en.help.countryFirst: Choose your country to see the right numbers. SymptoPage does not detect your location.
en.help.verified: Numbers checked on {date}. Your local health service is the final reference.
en.help.historyBody: Open your records or the doctor report to show them to a medical professional.
en.help.triageUnavailable: Not available in this version. SymptoPage does not assess how urgent your symptoms are and cannot tell you that everything is fine.
en.contact.patientInfoPL: NFZ patient information line, 24/7: night and holiday care, nearest emergency department
en.contact.nhs111: NHS 111 — urgent medical help that is not a 999 emergency
en.settings.notifyDetailsHint: Off by default: notifications can appear on the lock screen.
en.settings.background: Keep running in the notification area when the window is closed
en.settings.backgroundHint: Needed for reminders while the window is closed. Quit from the tray icon.
en.settings.notifyLimits: Reminders appear only while SymptoPage is running and the computer is awake. Nothing is shown while the computer is off or asleep, or if Windows notifications or Focus assist block them. Missed reminders are not replayed later; the dose stays “not marked”.
en.settings.testSent: Test sent. If nothing appeared, check Windows notification settings for SymptoPage.
en.settings.notifyUnsupported: Notifications are not available on this system.
en.settings.backupIntro: A backup file contains all records and attached documents. It is NOT encrypted — store it safely.
en.settings.importHint: Merge adds new records and keeps the newer version of changed ones; importing the same file twice adds nothing. A safety copy is made before every import.
en.settings.replaceConfirm: All current data will be replaced by the file's contents. A safety copy of the current data is made first and can be restored below.
en.settings.mergeReport: Merged: {added} added, {unchanged} unchanged, {updated} updated from file, {kept} kept local.
en.settings.missingFiles: {n} attached file(s) were not in the backup.
en.settings.autoBackupsHint: Made before data migration, import and restore. Restoring first saves the current state.
en.settings.localDetail: Records are stored unencrypted in your Windows user profile. Use Windows account protection and disk encryption (BitLocker) if others use this computer.
en.settings.aboutBody: Local symptom journal and visit companion. No account, cloud sync, analytics or data sharing.
en.settings.licences: Font: Manrope, SIL Open Font License 1.1. Third-party notices: NOTICE.md in the installation folder.
en.problem.title: Your data could not be opened
en.problem.body: Nothing was overwritten. The original file stays in the data folder.
en.problem.restoreConfirm: Restore {name}? The current file is kept beside it.
en.problem.freshBody: The damaged file is renamed and kept, so it can still be recovered by a specialist.
en.problem.fresh: Keep damaged file and start empty
en.problem.freshConfirm: The app will start with no records. The damaged file stays in the data folder.
en.problem.freshDone: Started empty. Damaged file kept as {name}.
en.migration.done: Your data was updated to the new format ({entries} entries). The original was saved as {backup}.
en.delete.entriesKept: Symptom records are kept: {n} will lose this link, {general} will become general records.
en.delete.irreversible: This cannot be undone except by restoring a backup.
en.delete.archiveInstead: To hide it but keep the history, use Archive instead.
en.error.save: Could not save. Your previous data is unchanged.
en.error.invalid: Check the entered data and try again.
en.error.unreadable: Data cannot be changed until it is restored.
en.error.open: The file could not be opened.
en.ios.notifyLimits: iOS delivers reminders even when SymptoPage is closed, but not while the phone is off, and Focus or notification settings can silence them. Up to 60 upcoming reminders are scheduled at a time; opening the app refreshes them.
en.ios.noSync: Moving a backup file between devices is a manual copy, not automatic synchronisation.
en.reminder.title: SymptoPage reminder
en.reminder.generic: You have a scheduled entry. Open SymptoPage to mark it.
